repo_notes.content: This repository is a fork of godotengine/godot tracking upstream `master` at version 4.7-beta (see `version.py`: major=4, minor=7, status="beta"; upstream commit 6d6e822c68 'Bump version to 4.7-beta'). The only fork-specific addition so far is the `steel_streets/` Godot game project (merged in PR #2). Describe the engine as 4.7-beta, not 4.3/4.5/4.6. `misc/extension_api_validation/4.6-stable/` holds the GDExtension compatibility notes for changes since the last stable release.

Team workflow commands (from the repo environment blueprint): build with `scons tests=yes target=editor dev_build=yes -j$(nproc)` (linking needs ~8 GB RAM; swap is configured on dev VMs); run unit tests with `./bin/godot.linuxbsd.editor.dev.x86_64 --headless --test`, filtering with `--test-case="*Name*"`; lint/format via `pre-commit run --files <paths>` using `.pre-commit-config.yaml` (clang-format, clang-tidy, ruff, mypy, codespell, file-format, header-guards, copyright-headers, validate-xml, dotnet-format, etc.). Always include these exact commands where build/test/lint are discussed.

Recent architectural changes (Feb-Apr 2026) that pages must reflect: (1) `GDType` (`core/object/gdtype.h/.cpp`) now owns signal and enum registration previously held by `ClassDB`/`ClassInfo`, with caches across supertypes; GDExtension placeholders use the real GDType. (2) New GDExtension interface functions `classdb_construct_object3` and `classdb_register_extension_class6` (refcount-aware construction) and `Variant::get_type_by_name`. (3) Visual shaders live in `modules/visual_shader/` (moved out of scene/ and editor/ into a module with its own `editor/` subfolder and `vs_nodes/`). (4) `AreaLight3D` (`scene/3d/light_3d.h`) with GLES3 support (`drivers/gles3/shaders/area_lights_inc.glsl`) and lightmapper support (`modules/lightmapper_rd/lm_area_lights_inc.glsl`). (5) RenderingDevice raytracing lists (`ID_TYPE_RAYTRACING_LIST`) and refactored raytracing pipelines / multi-geometry BLAS creation. (6) HDR output support on DisplayServer (Wayland, macOS/Apple, Windows; Vulkan on macOS) and `Image.save_exr` HDR screenshots. (7) New texture resources `DPITexture` (`scene/resources/dpi_texture.h`, SVG import) and `DrawableTexture2D` (`scene/resources/drawable_texture_2d.h`). (8) `View3DController` (`scene/debugger/view_3d_controller.h`) shared by the 3D editor viewport and the Game view runtime camera. (9) `Control` gained `custom_maximum_size`, offset transform, `_get_cursor_shape()`; `ScrollContainer` gained `SCROLL_MODE_MAXIMIZE_FIRST`; PopupMenu gained a fuzzy search bar.

Directory map reminders: the editor is organized by feature folders (`editor/animation`, `editor/docks`, `editor/inspector`, `editor/scene` (2D/3D/GUI editor plugins and gizmos), `editor/script`, `editor/shader`, `editor/import`, `editor/export`, `editor/run` (game view, embedded process), `editor/debugger`, `editor/settings`, `editor/themes`, `editor/project_manager`). Accessibility is `servers/display/accessibility_server.h` with the AccessKit backend in `drivers/accesskit/` (libs fetched by `misc/scripts/install_accesskit.py`). Game controllers use SDL (`drivers/sdl/joypad_sdl.cpp`). Metal is `drivers/metal/`, D3D12 is `drivers/d3d12/`, Apple platforms share `drivers/apple_embedded/` and `platform/ios` + `platform/visionos`. Navigation is split into `servers/navigation_2d|3d` and `modules/navigation_2d|3d`; physics backends are `modules/godot_physics_2d|3d` and `modules/jolt_physics`. `servers/movie_writer/` implements Movie Maker mode.

Scope guidance: `thirdparty/` is vendored upstream code — document which libraries exist and how they are integrated/updated (`thirdparty/README.md`), but do not explain their internals. `doc/classes/*.xml` and `modules/*/doc_classes/*.xml` are the class reference and should be cited as the public API contract. Cite concrete file paths and class names that exist in the repo; do not invent files or pipelines.

pages.title: Overview
pages.purpose: High-level map of the Godot 4.7-beta engine fork: layered architecture (core, scene, servers, modules, platform/drivers, editor), top-level directories, and the fork-specific steel_streets project. End with a concise glossary of key engine terms (SceneTree, Viewport, RID, ClassDB, GDType, GDExtension, RenderingDevice, DisplayServer, PackedScene, TextServer, Forward+/Mobile/Compatibility).

page_notes.content: Replaces the former standalone Glossary page; keep the glossary as a table at the bottom of this page.

page_notes.content: Merges the old 'Building from Source (SCons)' and 'Test Suite' pages. Include the exact team commands from repo notes and the test binary path bin/godot.linuxbsd.editor.dev.x86_64. Mention tests/display_server_mock.h, tests/signal_watcher.h, tests/test_macros.h and the create_test.py helper.

pages.title: Steel Streets Demo Game
pages.purpose: The fork-specific Game Boy style beat-'em-up/platformer project in steel_streets/: project configuration, scene flow, GDScript architecture, and the procedural asset generator.

page_notes.content: Base this page ONLY on files under steel_streets/ (README.md, project.godot, scenes/*.tscn, scripts/*.gd, tools/gen_assets.py). The previous version cited GDScript compiler sources and described a texture-compression pipeline that does not exist; do not repeat that.

Facts to cover: 160x144 internal viewport scaled to 640x576 with stretch mode 'viewport' and nearest-neighbor filtering (default_texture_filter=0); gl_compatibility renderer; 4-color GB palette #e0f8d0/#88c070/#346856/#081820; `GameManager` autoload (scripts/game_manager.gd) holding lives/score/HP, signals score_changed/lives_changed/hp_changed, and scene transitions goto_title/goto_splash/goto_level/goto_game_over/goto_victory; input actions move_left, move_right, jump, attack, climb_up, climb_down.

Scene flow: title_screen -> splash_screen -> level_1 -> game_over or victory -> title. Entities: player.gd, enemy_base.gd with foot_soldier.gd and shuriken_thrower.gd subclasses, boss.gd, projectile.gd, question_block.gd, hud.gd, anim_util.gd.

tools/gen_assets.py uses Pillow and the wave module to procedurally generate every PNG sprite (assets/sprites/{player,enemies,items,projectiles,tiles,ui}) and WAV sound (assets/audio) from code; run `python3 steel_streets/tools/gen_assets.py`. Run the game with `godot --path steel_streets` (project declares 4.3 features but runs on this 4.7 build).
